title: Bewildered No More Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Bewildered is a spacious two-story penthouse apartment that offers the best of new urbanism living. Located on the third and fourth floor of the 25 Central Square Building in the heart of Seaside, this unit offers panoramic Gulf views that can be enjoyed from the privacy of your own balcony or three common areas.
description_expanded: Description25 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT 3061 KING, 2 TWINS, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFABewildered… No More | Penthouse Condo Above Seaside’s Central SquareLocated just above Seaside’s iconic Central Square, Bewildered… No More is a completely reimagined two-story penthouse condo in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Formerly known as Bewildered, this residence has undergone a full “to-the-studs” renovation, featuring all-new furnishings, modern finishes, and elevated design throughout. Steps from the beach, shops, restaurants, and Seaside Pavilion, this sophisticated retreat places you at the center of everything Seaside has to offer.Unmatched Location in the Heart of SeasidePerfectly positioned above Central Square, this penthouse offers immediate walkability to Seaside’s beach access, dining, shopping, and cultural events. Guests enjoy convenient access to both Coleman Pavilion and Seaside Pavilion, making beach days effortless and sunsets unforgettable—all without needing a car.Open-Concept Living with Gulf ViewsUpon entry, guests are welcomed into an expansive open-concept kitchen, dining, and family room that opens onto a private balcony. The space is anchored by an impressive 11-foot island with seating for five, offering views into both the beautifully remodeled kitchen and the comfortable living area.The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with high-end appliances, including an induction cooktop, Liebherr refrigerator, and KitchenAid oven/microwave, ideal for entertaining or relaxed meals at home. The family room features a large-screen cable TV, sleeper sofa, and three plush chairs, while the dining table for six sits beside west-facing windows—perfect for enjoying sunset dinners.Step outside onto the private balcony, furnished with a café table and chairs, where evening cocktails are elevated by sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico, Seaside rooftops, and Scenic Highway 30A.A newly added half bath and stackable washer and dryer are conveniently located on this level. Just outside the unit, guests may also enjoy a shared exterior courtyard with comfortable seating and panoramic coastal views.Luxurious Bedrooms & Spa-Inspired BathsUpstairs, the primary bedroom serves as a serene retreat, featuring a king bed, large-screen TV, and a luxurious private bathroom complete with a soaking tub, separate shower, trough sink, and spacious vanity.The second bedroom includes two twin beds, a desk, and closet, with a fully remodeled bathroom located just steps away—perfect for families or additional guests.Private Rooftop Patio with Pavilion & Gulf ViewsOne of the most exceptional features of Bewildered… No More is the hidden private rooftop patio, accessed from the upstairs hallway. This elevated outdoor living space is fully furnished with two lounge chairs, a sofa for three, cocktail tables, a drink bar with stools, refrigerator, and sink.From this rooftop retreat, enjoy a rare direct view of the Seaside Pavilion and the Gulf of Mexico—a stunning backdrop for daytime lounging, sunset gatherings, and starlit evenings.Art-Filled Design & Architectural SignificanceAn art lover’s dream, the penthouse showcases striking photography by world-renowned photographers and features a dramatic six-foot mermaid sculpture adorning the stairway wall. Additional photographic displays throughout the upper level create a gallery-like experience that captivates guests at every turn.The residential-commercial building itself is an architectural landmark, designed by acclaimed architects Rodolfo Machado and Jorge Silvetti. It received the Massachusetts Design Award (1991) and a Progressive Architecture Citation (1992), adding historic significance to this exceptional Seaside stay.Access, Parking & ConvenienceThe building features a secure keypad elevator providing access to the third-floor penthouse entry. While the unit does not include an assigned parking space, parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis behind the 25 Central Square building.A One-of-a-Kind Seaside, Florida PenthouseBlending refined design, curated art, and unforgettable Gulf views, Bewildered… No More offers a truly unique Seaside vacation experience. Perfect for beach lovers, art enthusiasts, and guests seeking to stay in the very heart of Seaside, this pristine penthouse delivers comfort, culture, and coastal beauty—all in one remarkable retreat.5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer | 3-night Fall | 2-night minimum winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES:1,360 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceSeaside beach access at Coleman PavilionLocated only 167 feet (approximately a 1-minute walk) to beach accessOne parking pass issued for the unitAdditional parking available behind 25 Central Square or along Quincy CircleAdditional vehicles may park in paid parking areas at the daily rateAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerFull-size washer and dryer for guest conveniencePeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towelsWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stayStarter amenities provided upon arrivalGolf carts are considered vehiclesGolf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
